_about: Scripts run on a Databricks SQL warehouse (channel Current, v2026.43) on 2026-11-06. Every entry in 'valid' ran successfully (a parse error would have failed it); every entry in 'rejected' was refused by the engine. The block-structure checker must report nothing on 'valid'. Synthetic: no real tables, no real data. The a-numbered entries come from an adversarial pass that tried to make the block checker (or an older check) flag a script the engine accepts; each was a real false positive or a close call, and the checker now says nothing about any of them.
